title: Add the documentation specialist profile so opum-workflow documenter can compile its context pack (OPAG-688)
description: Filed on opum-agent's dispatch (OPAG-688, 2026-09-28). origin/dev carries only three .lore/agents/ profiles (implementation, review, verification): OPAG-33 left the fourth out for uniformity, OPAG-417 has since given all four to five more repositories, so uniformity now means four. The opum-workflow documenter specialist compiles its pack from the 'documentation' profile, so it cannot dispatch in this repository until this file exists. The ruling and its measurement live on opum-ai/opum-agent's OPAG-688.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `.lore/agents/documentation.toml` lands on dev, sized like OPAG-33's lore-cli pack budgets (implementation 20000, review 18000, verification 16000)

`lore agent context documentation --task "<something real>"` is captured BEFORE and AFTER the file lands; after, stderr carries no `warning: agent profile "documentation" was not found` AND the pack's catalog comes from the profile's sources ("exits 0 with a non-empty pack" alone is NOT the proof: without a profile lore 0.11.0 exits 0 with the degraded pack, LCLI-575)
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0

implementationNotes: OPAG-688 corrected AC (orchestrator, 2026-09-28): mere exit-0-with-non-empty-pack is the degraded pack and would certify a missing profile; require the no-warning + catalog-source pair, captured before and after.
Filed at the orchestrator's request to move the record up; the implementation still waits for the 632/634-639 campaign boundary.
